name: TryAnneal
description: Agent trust infrastructure for Mantle. A multi-LLM smart-contract audit agent (ChainGPT pre-screen; two cross-validating Groq critics — Llama-3.3-70B + OpenAI GPT-OSS-120B; Slither + Aderyn static analysis; a 98-pattern, $7.1B exploit corpus; Tencent Cloud Hunyuan for 14-language report translation) that posts is_this_safe() verdicts on-chain via the AnnealValidation registry. Any agent can read a verdict before composing with unknown code.
